findings.issue_summary: Data Safety Compliant (Local-Only): music triage is a false positive
findings.evidence: MainActivity.kt:332,517,553-571 uses trackingSpeedScore, Compose trackColor and exercise trackModes. PreferencesManager.kt:46-58,67-69 stores exercise capability scores and marker path selection in SharedPreferences. EyeExerciseOverlayService.kt:133,188-189,553-562 calculates marker exercise paths and uses GazeTracker for camera frames at 635-640. None refers to user music files or transmits music.
findings.recommendation: Exclude MUSIC from declarations based on these false-positive track matches; re-evaluate only if actual music-library functionality is introduced.
findings.purpose: Local visual exercise configuration; no music source

findings.evidence: PreferencesManager.kt:67-69 exposes savedChatHistory through private SharedPreferences string chat_history; no network sink. AiCoachChatDialog sends the user query directly to GeminiNanoCoachManager.getCoachResponse and retains messages in a remembered list. GeminiNanoCoachManager uses ML Kit on-device Generation.getClient/generateContent or a local deterministic response; no visible off-device chat upload.
findings.recommendation: Document local chat processing accurately. Verify release SDK behavior and backup handling separately; no chat collection declaration is established by these local-only paths.

findings.issue_summary: Data Safety Compliant (Local-Only): own-package version lookup
findings.evidence: AppVersionManager.kt:27 and 36 call getPackageInfo(context.packageName, 0) only for this application's version. checkForUpdate compares local constants. triggerAutoUpdate copies this application's own APK to cache and opens Package Installer only on user action. These calls do not enumerate installed apps or transmit an app inventory.
findings.recommendation: Do not infer an installed-app inventory from own-package version lookups. Accessibility usage events are a separate source covered by the restricted-permission audit.

findings.issue_summary: Data Safety Compliant (Local-Only): browsing-history triage is a false positive
findings.evidence: MainActivity.kt has no WebView/loadUrl call or visited-site history source. The triage pattern loadUrl matches the downloadUrl identifier used by triggerAutoUpdate at line 787. A separate user-selected navigation action opens a fixed Naver map search via ACTION_VIEW around line 476; it does not read or send prior browsing history.
findings.recommendation: Exclude WEB_BROWSING_HISTORY based on these false positives; distinguish opening a user-requested link from collecting visited websites.
